icon.actualPrompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: macOS application icon master
Primary request: Create a clean, original square application icon for Film Studio Engine F0: abstract aperture formed by three flowing film-strip arcs around a small luminous frame.
Scene/backdrop: deep graphite background.
Style/medium: minimal vector-friendly 3D icon with a strong geometric silhouette and premium polished finish.
Composition/framing: single centered mark, generous padding, balanced negative space, readable at small sizes.
Lighting/mood: restrained cinematic glow.
Color palette: electric teal and warm amber accents on deep graphite.
Text: none.
Constraints: original design only; no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark, no Blender swirl or Blender mark, no mockup, no device frame.

splash.actualPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: desktop application startup splash master
Primary request: Create an original cinematic software splash image for Film Studio Engine F0.
Scene/backdrop: abstract dark soundstage horizon with subtle volumetric light beams.
Subject: a geometric camera-gate or frame motif suggesting film production, without resembling any existing software logo.
Style/medium: premium minimal cinematic concept art, clean and restrained.
Composition/framing: exact 2:1 landscape intent; focal motif centered-right; ample dark negative space in the upper-left for application UI; readable when cropped to 1000 by 500 pixels.
Lighting/mood: quiet, confident, cinematic glow.
Color palette: deep graphite with electric teal and warm amber accents.
Text: none.
Constraints: original design only; no people, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark, no Blender swirl or Blender mark, no interface mockup.

operations: Resized the square icon master to 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, and 1024 pixel iconset representations without compositing.
Compiled the iconset to ICNS with /usr/bin/iconutil.
Resized the exact 2:1 splash master to 1000x500 RGB PNG without cropping, compositing, or added text.
